title: You Think Bigger Rewards Buy Stronger Belief, Yet Paying One Dollar Beat Paying Twenty
description:
You think bigger rewards buy stronger human belief! Yet one dollar changed minds while twenty dollars failed! This is the true story of Leon Festinger's Stanford study. Here is what went wrong inside a Stanford basement.
